verses.english: The Exterior as Impermanent in the Three Times

verses.pali: “Rūpā, bhikkhave, aniccā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā. Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā aniccā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, in the past … future … present sights, sounds, smells, tastes, touches, and ideas are impermanent …”
